    AI Overview
    +5
    The 2026 Masters Tournament takes place April 6–12 at Augusta National, featuring Rounds 1 & 2 on April 9–10, and the final rounds on April 11–12. Key coverage is on ESPN (3–7:30 p.m. ET) and CBS. Round 2 tee times on Friday start at 7:40 a.m. ET, featuring groupings like Jon Rahm and Jordan Spieth. 
    2026 Masters Key Schedule & TV (All Times ET) 
    • Thursday, April 9 (Round 1): 3-7:30 p.m. (ESPN), 1-3 p.m. (Prime Video)
    • Friday, April 10 (Round 2): 3-7:30 p.m. (ESPN), 1-3 p.m. (Prime Video)
    • Saturday, April 11 (Round 3): 2-7 p.m. (CBS), 12-2 p.m. (Paramount+)
    • Sunday, April 12 (Round 4):
      12-7 p.m. (CBS), 12-2 p.m. (Paramount+)
       
    Friday Round 2 Featured Tee Times (ET) 
    • 7:40 a.m. – Sam Stevens, Sungjae Im
    • 8:38 a.m. – Adam Scott, Daniel Berger, Brian Harman
    • 9:43 a.m. – Jon Rahm, Chris Gotterup, Ludvig Åberg
    • 9:55 a.m. – Jordan Spieth, Justin Rose, Brooks Koepka
    • 10:19 a.m. – Scottie Scheffler, Robert MacIntyre, Gary Woodland
    • 10:31 a.m. – Rory McIlroy, Cameron Young, Mason Howell (a) 
    How to Watch 
    • Streaming: Masters Live (free on CBS Sports app), Paramount+
    • Featured Groups & Amen Corner: Live on Masters.com and ESPN App
    • Radio: SiriusXM 
    Note: All times are approximate and subject to change due to weather.
